-- Find races where the same driver got pole, won, and had fastest lap
WITH pole AS (
    SELECT rbind, pilotrec as driver_id 
    FROM qualifying WHERE px_pos = 1
),
winner AS (
    SELECT rlink as race_id, drive_link as driver_id 
    FROM driver_standings WHERE px = 1
),
fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT lt.rc_index as race_id, lt.wheel_unit as driver_id
    FROM lap_times lt
    INNER JOIN (SELECT rc_index, MIN(msec_val) as min_ms FROM lap_times GROUP BY rc_index) fl
    ON lt.rc_index = fl.rc_index AND lt.msec_val = fl.min_ms
)
SELECT p.rbind, p.driver_id
FROM pole p
JOIN winner w ON p.rbind = w.race_id AND p.driver_id = w.driver_id
JOIN fastest_lap fl ON p.rbind = fl.race_id AND p.driver_id = fl.driver_id;
